lines: +# Tool-call execution in training vs. what the model actually called
+The loop fed each raw `/generate` text straight to SGLang's tool parser, with no reasoning
+separation, so it acted on text the deploy endpoint (reasoning parser first, then tool
+parser) would never hand to a client — and two of the pinned SGLang one-shot detectors are
+ themselves unsafe to this equivalence: `qwen3_coder` parses a call whose `<tool_call>` block
+was never closed (fallback in `detect_and_parse`) and `glm47` JSON-parses every argument
+value and re-dumps string arguments (hence the 6 reformatted/newline-stripped
+`answer.json` contents). Fix: `examples/tool_agent/tool_call_parsing.py` separates reasoning
+with the model's own SGLang reasoning parser (force-reasoning resolved from template +
+kwargs as in `serving_chat`, corrected per turn by whether the actual prompt ends inside a
+reasoning block — the Oct 8 run's first prompt pre-closed `<think>` while later turns open
+it) and then extracts only complete calls in the model's native format, converting untyped
+XML argument strings by the tool's JSON schema (a string argument is passed through
+verbatim, including JSON-looking text, numbers, and the literal `null`; `timeout`'s
+`anyOf [number, null]` converts numerically). Beyond the recorded models, this also covers
+`qwen25` calls without the detector's exact newlines, Llama-3.1 bare-JSON calls (the
+`llama3` detector requires them at offset 0), and gpt-oss calls in the recipient-first
+harmony header its own template renders (the `gpt-oss` detector only recognises the
+channel-first `<|constrain|>` form). Wiring: `launch/run_tool_agent.py` now also passes
+`--generate-reasoning-parser` from the existing per-model table; loop entry point and
+launcher interface unchanged, and nothing else in the rollout (tokens, loss masks,
+rewards, tool-result rendering) is touched.
+Verification: `tests/test_tool_call_parsing.py` (19 cases); template round-trips and
+synthetic end-to-end rollouts through the real loop/launcher for all 7 models; replay of
+all four recorded runs against the old loop (GLM SQL identical, GLM data differs only in
+the 6 known `file_text`s now preserved verbatim, Qwen3-1.7B: 3 episodes — two reasoning
+drafts dropped and one real call recovered that a draft block used to swallow;
+Qwen3.5-2B: 406 episodes change trajectory; spare samples are identical wherever the
+executed calls don't change, and the only wider parser diffs are drops, plus a wanted
+`"NULL"` string argument no longer converted to `None`). Live batch run 1 on the H100 with
+the final loop: 160 rollouts (SQL 128, data 32), 0 errors.
